newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end lower, haunted by bank woes.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end lower, haunted by bank woes.

text.p: Tokyo stocks finished the Friday session sharply lower, haunted by worries over the financial health of the banking sector and intermittent bouts of futures-linked selling, stemming from a lack of confidence in the future of the economy, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average finished trade down 220.10 points, or 1.23 percent, at 17,689.36. Its March futures were down 250 points at 17,660.
"The slide in the U.S. markets overnight was what set off the selling in the morning," a "Big Four" broker said. "No one wants to be long over the weekend and that stopped buying."
